entities.summary: Eduard Ayangwa Folayang is a Filipino professional mixed martial artist and wushu practitioner who competes in the Lightweight division of ONE Championship, where he is a two-time ONE Lightweight World Champion. He also competed for Universal Reality Combat Championship, where he is a former URCC Welterweight Champion. Eduard Folayang was a athletes & competitors from Q1822 (b. 1984-11-22, Q1822).
